package consumer

import (
	och "ofam.dev/ochazuke"
)

func register(r *och.Runtime, noun, verb string) {
	r.Register(och.Operation{
		Noun: "task",
		Verb: "done",
		Run:  func(*och.Runtime, och.Context, och.Arguments) (any, error) { return nil, nil },
	})
	r.Register(och.Operation{Noun: noun, Verb: verb, App: func(och.Ctx) och.Result { return och.Done(nil) }})
	op := r.Operations["task.done"]
	op.Description = op.Noun + " " + op.Verb
	r.Operations[op.Key()] = op
	if got, ok := r.Operations[noun+"."+verb]; ok {
		got.Verb = "again"
		_ = got.App
	}
	for key, o := range r.Operations {
		_, _ = key, o.Key()
	}
	delete(r.Operations, op.Key())
	_ = len(r.Operations)
	var a och.Action
	_ = a
}
